general_dataset.label: General dataset prep (default)
general_dataset.description: Topic-agnostic triage for any dataset: keep the clear wins, send the maybes to Borderline for human review, drop the unrelated. No subject or person gates — works for photos, art, aerial, product, anything.
general_dataset.global_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for a camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image. Anime, illustration, 3D render, digital painting, or a photo of a statue/figurine -> the matching label, NEVER `photograph`.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (malformed face/hands, wrong finger count, melted limbs, warped text, impossible geometry).
- A SCREENSHOT is the WHOLE frame being a screen capture (UI chrome / browser bars). A photo that merely contains a phone or monitor as a scene object is NOT a screenshot.
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together -> is_composite_grid=true and DISCARD.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in watermarks, captions, logos, or infographic text.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
- The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score; do NOT invent details that aren't in the pixels.
This is a GENERAL dataset-prep triage. Keep the clear wins, send the maybes to Borderline for human review, and drop the unrelated. Judge quality on sharpness, exposure, composition and absence of artefacts - not on subject matter.

categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Strong on-topic example, no severe AI flaws, no watermark/overlay, OVR_Quality_Score >= 60 AND REL_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: On-topic and usable but average quality, or one minor issue (mild AI flaws, soft focus, light compression). Bucket for human review

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: Unrelated to the curation topic regardless of quality (REL_Quality_Score < 30)

portrait_curation.label: Portrait curation (influencer / model)
portrait_curation.description: Six-bucket taxonomy tuned for influencer / model photography. Keeps the strict photoreal + real-human gates. Select this preset when you specifically want person/portrait curation.
portrait_curation.global_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every binary judgement consistent with that description. Your description and labels MUST agree - if your description says 'boulder smashing a car' you cannot then say woman_present=true.
- BEFORE describing the subject, scan the WHOLE frame for: phone or browser UI elements, side-by-side panels or comparison grids, large text overlays / watermarks. If you see any of these, set the matching is_screenshot / is_composite_grid / contains_text_overlay field to true and MENTION it in `description`. These images are NEVER valid influencer photographs and category MUST be DISCARD.
- An image is a SCREENSHOT only when the WHOLE FRAME is a screen capture. A normal photograph that happens to CONTAIN a phone, monitor, or screen as objects in the scene is NOT a screenshot.
- An image is a COMPOSITE/GRID if it contains 2+ separate images, even if they all show similar subjects.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for an actual camera-captured (or AI-generated photoreal) image of a real-looking subject. Anime, cel-shaded art, hand-drawn illustration, oil/watercolour painting, comic, manga, stylised 3D, concept art -> the matching label, NEVER `photograph`.
- A photograph of a STATUE, BUST, MANNEQUIN, DOLL, or SCULPTURE is NOT a photograph of a real human. is_human_photograph is FALSE in those cases, and woman_present is FALSE even if the sculpture depicts a female form.
- photorealistic_style = TRUE ONLY when art_medium = `photograph` AND the subject reads as a real-world scene/person. Visible brush strokes, line art, cel shading, painterly textures, exaggerated proportions, or stylised lighting all force FALSE.
- woman_present = TRUE ONLY if a real human female face or body is clearly visible as the primary OR co-primary subject of the image. Background pedestrians do NOT count. Sculpted/illustrated/animated figures do NOT count. DO NOT INFER a woman from the topic, caption, prompt, or context.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (malformed face, wrong finger count, melted limbs, warped text).
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.

categories.name: InstagramInfluencer
categories.hint: photorealistic woman, social-media aesthetic, no nudity, no overlay

categories.name: NSFW
categories.hint: photorealistic woman AND explicit nudity/sexual content

categories.name: Professional
categories.hint: photorealistic woman, studio/editorial polish, no nudity, no overlay

categories.name: Amateur
categories.hint: photorealistic woman, casual/selfie style, no overlay

categories.name: Unknown
categories.hint: photorealistic woman but doesn't fit categories above

categories.name: Watermarked
categories.hint: photorealistic woman, all other gates pass, BUT contains_text_overlay=true (visible watermark, branded caption, logo overlay, infographic text). The shot itself is salvageable if the overlay is removed - so route here instead of DISCARD

lora_basic.label: LoRA dataset (3-bucket triage)
lora_basic.description: Minimal triage for LoRA / fine-tune dataset prep. Keep the obvious wins, send the rest to Borderline for human review. Drops the woman-specific gates so it works for any topic.
lora_basic.global_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES:
- Describe the pixels literally first; pick a category second. The description and labels must agree.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for camera-captured (or AI photoreal) images. Anime / illustration / 3D render / digital painting -> their respective label.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for severe artefacts (malformed faces, wrong finger count, warped text, melted limbs).
- A SCREENSHOT is the WHOLE frame being a screen capture. A photo that contains a phone/monitor as a scene object is not a screenshot.
- A COMPOSITE/GRID is 2+ separate images stitched together.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
- The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score; do NOT use it to invent details that aren't in the pixels.

categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: strong example of the curation topic, no severe AI flaws, no overlay/watermark, OVR_Quality_Score >= 60 AND REL_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: on-topic and usable but average quality, or one minor issue (mild AI flaws, soft focus). Bucket for human review

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: unrelated to the curation topic regardless of quality (REL_Quality_Score < 30)

art_style.label: By art medium
art_style.description: Sort an archive by what kind of image it is, not by quality. Useful for splitting a mixed dataset (photos + anime + 3D renders) into per-style training sets.
art_style.global_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES:
- Describe the pixels literally first; pick a category second.
- art_medium is the source of truth for routing. Choose ONE of: photograph, digital_painting, anime, 3d_render, illustration, mixed, unclear.
- A photo that has been heavily filtered (Instagram-style preset, soft glow) is still a photograph.
- AI photoreal that is genuinely indistinguishable from camera output is `photograph`.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
- The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score; do NOT use it to invent details that aren't in the pixels.

categories.name: Photograph
categories.hint: art_medium=photograph and photorealistic_style=true; real-world or photoreal AI subject

categories.name: Anime
categories.hint: anime / manga / cel-shaded aesthetic; visible line art, oversized eyes, flat colour fills, exaggerated proportions

categories.name: DigitalPainting
categories.hint: painterly textures, brush strokes visible, art_medium=digital_painting

categories.name: Render3D
categories.hint: 3D-rendered look, CGI lighting, art_medium=3d_render

categories.name: Illustration
categories.hint: vector / flat / line-art illustration, including comics and infographics

categories.name: Mixed
categories.hint: deliberately mixed-media composition, or doesn't clearly fit one of the buckets above

quality_only.label: By quality only
quality_only.description: Topic-agnostic quality triage. Routes purely on OVR_Quality_Score. Useful for filtering a personal archive without imposing a taxonomy.
quality_only.global_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES:
- Describe the pixels literally first; pick a category second.
- Route on OVR_Quality_Score only. The curation topic informs REL_Quality_Score but does not affect category here.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for severe artefacts.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.

categories.name: Top
categories.hint: OVR_Quality_Score >= 80, no severe AI flaws, no overlay

categories.name: Mid
categories.hint: OVR_Quality_Score 60-79

categories.name: Low
categories.hint: OVR_Quality_Score 40-59 OR mild AI flaws
